title: Side setback, walls above 7.1 m high (R30-R60)
text: C3.4.1 Buildings are set back from lot boundaries in accordance with Table 3.4a. Refer Figure 3.4a, b, c. Table 3.4a Lot boundary setbacks, side setback: Wall height above 7.1m 2.0m.

replaces.note: walls 7.1-10 m and 10.1 m+ 3 m -> 2.0 m; direction unclear given Table 4A's 3.5 m (C4P1-085)

verified.note: Table 3.4a (p32) prints 2.0m for 'Wall height above 7.1m'; Table 4A (p7) prints 3.5m for '7.1m and above (3rd storey)'; Figure 3.4l (p35) shows 3m each side. Three values on the pages for the same setback; Table 3.4a encoded. Table 3.4a (p32) prints the bands as 'Wall height up to 3.5m', 'Wall height 3.6m to 7m' and 'Wall height above 7.1m', leaving 3.5-3.6 m and 7.0-7.1 m undefined; Table 4A (p7) prints '3.6m -7m (2nd storey)' and '7.1m and above (3rd storey)'. The encoded band conditions (> 3.5, > 7.0) are an inference.

notes: from: ch3 C3.4.1#side-over-7.1m-r30-r40 and C3.4.1#side-over-7.1m-r50, merged into one R30-R60 record (same Table 3.4a value 2.0 m, no pedestrian access way reduction above R25; Chapter 4 Part 1 has no R80+ or R100-SL codes). Applies only where the building has walls 7.1 m high and above (condition on building.has_walls_over_7_1m); the band does not depend on the building's maximum wall height. Rounding gap between wall-height bands unresolved. CONFLICT: Table 4A (p7) shows 3.5 m for walls 7.1 m and above (third storey) against Table 3.4a's 2.0 m; current Part C is 3 m and Figure 3.4l still shows 3 m + 3 m (register C4P1-003 conflict 1, C4P1-085). Table 3.4a is encoded.
